prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Conroe, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1062; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to talk with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me where the accident happened?

A: It was on a two-lane road in Conroe, Texas, near a small shopping center.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I was driving home from work. I was heading in one direction and the other car was coming toward me in the opposite lane.

Q: How fast were you going?

A: I'd say maybe twenty-five or thirty miles an hour. Traffic was slow.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other driver drifted into my lane. I tried to steer away but we still hit head-on, though it wasn't a hard impact.

Q: Did either airbag deploy?

A: No, they didn't. My seatbelt was on, and I got out of the car on my own.

Q: Did you go to a doctor or the emergency room?

A: I went to urgent care that same evening. They said I had a neck strain.

Q: Where are you feeling the pain now?

A: Mostly in my neck and the upper part of my shoulders. Turning my head to the left is the hardest. Some mornings I also get a dull headache.

Q: Have you missed any work because of it?

A: I've missed two days so far. I'm still following up with my doctor about it.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'll send over the urgent care paperwork when I get it.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
